tldr: Black Moon Lilith transiting the 4th house: autonomy and the disowned self activate through home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations.
body: Black Moon Lilith moving through the 4th house can activate the disowned, uncompromising self through home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations. For roughly nine months, this transit may expose where shame, control, compliance, or refusal has gathered in this part of life. The ungovernable self lives at home and in family; you refuse the roles you were assigned there. A deep wound around home and family: a restlessness that never quite feels at home and an urge to cut roots, paired with sharp perception of other people's hidden motives. It can also mark a significant early event or focus involving a parent or the family home, carried forward as a heavy, formative weight.
business: The disowned self activates through home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations. Reclaims power over your own roots and private life.
shadow: Family rupture, or a home life ruled by old repression.
advice: Reclaim autonomy in the 4th house without letting reaction make the decision for you. Work with home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations directly and consciously.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Black Moon Lilith house placement material.
